mapper.insert: INSERT INTO withdrawal ( account_id, requested_amount, destination_account_no, destination_general_account_id, processed_at, status ) VALUES( #{accountId}, #{requestedAmount}, #{destinationAccountNo}, #{destinationGeneralAccountId}, #{processedAt}, #{status} )

INSERT INTO withdrawal_allocation( withdrawal_id, left_amount_id, allocated_amount, withdrawal_at, type )VALUES( #{withdrawalId}, #{leftAmountId}, #{allocatedAmount}, #{withdrawalAt}, #{type}
)
mapper.select: SELECT la.left_amount_id, la.exchange_id, la.cur_amount, ke.final_at FROM left_amount la JOIN krw_exchange ke on la.exchange_id=ke.exchange_id WHERE ke.account_id = #{accountId} AND ke.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND ke.final_at IS NOT NULL AND la.cur_amount > 0 ORDER BY ke.final_at ASC, ke.exchange_id ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(allocated_amount), 0) FROM withdrawal_allocation WHERE withdrawal_id = #{withdrawalId} AND type = 'IMMATURE_PRINCIPAL_INCLUDED'
